title: The Vision
narration: What if engineering was less about typing code — and more about solving the problems that actually matter? Not writing boilerplate. Not chasing reviews. The real work — thinking, designing, deciding. Coder becomes engineer. Engineer becomes builder. The value shifts from 'can you write this' to 'can you think through this.'

title: Meet Tara
narration: Hi. I'm Tara. TARA — Threaded AI Resource Agent. My name means star in Hindi. I'm the teammate who never sleeps. I live in your Slack threads. I read your code, your JIRA tickets, your PRs. And I build alongside you.
notes: Tara's 3D character animates in with gentle smile against blue-to-gold gradient. Particle effects shimmer. Text reveals: 'TARA — Threaded AI Resource Agent' then 'तारा — Star in Hindi'.

title: Story A — Race Condition Detective
narration: Nayni suspected a race condition between two services. I confirmed it — identified the exact Redis deduplication gap between check and set, named the specific functions, and generated a full root cause analysis. Not a suggestion. A diagnosis.
notes: Title card: 'Real stories. Real engineers. Real Slack threads.' dissolves into first story. Split screen: conversation left, RCA PDF right. Bold red text: 'CRITICAL RACE CONDITION CONFIRMED.'

title: Story B — The Async Planning Loop
narration: Sai needed Google Ads campaign creation. I planned it. Yaswanth reviewed and found an architectural issue. I corrected. A second engineer jumped in and said three words: 'Make it real.' I did. Eighty-seven messages. Multiple engineers. Fully asynchronous. This is how building works now.
notes: Counter shows '87 replies.' Close-up on 'Make it real' message appears word by word. Dramatic pause. Coding agent progress card animates through steps.

title: Story C — The Coding Agent
narration: When you're ready to build, just tell me. I clone the repo. I study your team's patterns — their PRs, their commit style, their architecture. I implement, verify, and open a pull request. All while you move on to the next problem worth solving.
notes: Screen recording style. Each step checks off with satisfying animation. Replace Siren logo with Tara logo in all screenshots.
